title: World map: hand-drawn country pins
kaylee: Every country on the map now has its own little friend to tap: a moose, a pizza, a camel, a panda, an elephant, a llama, a kangaroo and a penguin, drawn to match the map.

pictures.title: On the iPhone
pictures.caption: The system emoji are gone: each pin is a drawing in the map's own flat style

pictures.title: On the iPad
pictures.caption: Same pins, same places, same size to tap
